name: Business operations specialist
description: Answers for APQC process group 5.4, Deliver service to customer: takes one signed engagement from its statement of work to a closed record, builds and tests each deliverable against its acceptance test, prices every change first, and harvests the close review. A person signs, approves every change and sends every word to the client.

onet.title: Business Operations Specialists, All Other
onet.basis: Process group 5.4 is initiating, executing and completing service delivery for one engagement, which O*NET files under no single occupation, since the work depends on the service sold; this catch-all title is a placeholder until a venture names the service, matched by the group's processes against O*NET 31.0.

questions: What does this engagement owe the client, by its statement of work?
